messages:
Eli: Noticing oddness in invoice-preview: a handful of tenants show token counts but zero cost. That's new after route-resolver v2 canary. Link: https://console/redwood/invoice-preview/tenant/forge :thinking:
Vera: I saw 2 tenants with that pattern. Investigating raw billing_events, `price_plan` is present but price_per_token = 0 in the enrichment output.
Tom: ingest-bot: canary started route-resolver:v2 -> 7% at 1715200800
ingest-bot: sample raw event: {tenant: "forge", tokens: 220, route_id: "r-new-4", route_alias: "fast-text"}
billing-bot: enrichment output: {tenant: "forge", tokens: 220, price_plan: "standard", price_per_token: 0.0, total_cost: 0.0} -> upstream invoice preview shows $0
Vera: quick triage: two possible causes: (1) price table lookup key changed (route_id vs route_alias), (2) currency/units normalization bug when v2 returns numeric price as string.
Eli: can we run a small query to check events where price_plan IS NOT NULL and price_per_token = 0?
Vera: running: ```SELECT tenant, count(*) as n_zero_price FROM billing_events WHERE price_plan IS NOT NULL AND price_per_token = 0 AND ts > now() - interval '60 minutes' GROUP BY tenant ORDER BY n_zero_price DESC LIMIT 20;```
Vera: result: forge=412, atelier=98, quill=14. All start around canary start time.
Tom: short-term fix: enrichment should default price_per_token from price_catalog by route_id then alias then tenant_plan. I'll push a safe fallback to use tenant_plan price if lookup yields zero. PR incoming.
Eli: console UX ask: when price_per_token == 0 but price_plan present, show a warning badge "pricing uncertain" and link to raw event sample. That prevents PMs from assuming free usage.
Vera: also add metric metering.price.lookup_failures and graph it on the metering overview; set alert when >0.1% of events return zero price for 10m.
Tom: will add logging to enrichment: emit `pricing_lookup_key=route_id` and `lookup_result_type=zero|found|missing` in traces. PR: https://git/repo/pull/1489
Eli: follow-ups: (1) hotfix fallback (Tom), (2) console warning + sample link (Eli), (3) metric + alert (Vera), (4) backfill dry-run to recompute price_per_token for last 2h (Vera).
billing-bot: quick calc (after fallback applied in staging): forge unattributed_zero_price events dropped from 412 -> 3 in a 15m sample.
Tom: pushing hotfix to canary edge; keeping canary paused until metric <0.05% for 30m.
ingest-bot: canary paused route-resolver:v2 (id=cr-2026-03-22-004) - hold reason: pricing lookup failures exceeded threshold
Eli: I'll draft the console change + helptext and link it to rollout checklist: "pricing projection + zero-price guard" is required before >10% canary.
Vera: I'll prepare the backfill dry-run and upload diffs to S3 for review. If diff is small we'll run it to correct invoice preview.
Tom: thanks. Adding unit tests for price_catalog lookup precedence and string->float normalization.
Eli: closing thread, will follow up with PR links and S3 diffs.
